title: Visual Supports and Communication Boards
sub: Build and print the visuals a plan needs at true size: communication boards with a category band and velcro dots, picture-card sheets for cutting, large rule cards (safe hands, walking feet, sitting, waiting, quiet voice), first-then boards, visual schedules, choice boards, token boards, wait and countdown cards, and a feelings scale. Pictures come from the shared pictogram library or from photos you upload.
